title: VadAnnotation 1.0.0
description: A human annotation of speech boundaries in one real recording, used to evaluate an acoustic boundary provider. It is bound to the recording by sha256 so a prediction produced from different audio cannot be scored against it. It carries no accuracy result and no product threshold: it is input evidence for an evaluation, not a measurement policy.

annotator.description: Who made the manual decision. A machine-generated or synthetic annotation must not be recorded here as if it were human review.

annotated_regions.description: Time ranges a human actually listened to and labelled. Optional and additive: with the field absent or empty the whole recording is treated as annotated. A produced segment outside these regions is reported as unmeasurable rather than as a false alarm.

intervals.description: Annotated speech intervals, ordered and non-overlapping, on the recording's audio-relative millisecond time base. Silence is everything inside an annotated region that is not listed here; it is never inferred from an absent field.

boundary_uncertainty_ms.description: How precisely the annotator could place a boundary. Recorded separately from any provider's uncertainty so the two are never confused.
